about_the_game:
Awaken from your Lethargy, a sci-fi game that blurs the line between nightmare and truth. You find yourself in a desolate, futuristic place, with no memory and no idea how you got there. Every light and echo of silence whispers secrets of your life. The most pressing question haunts you: are you truly awake, or trapped in an endless nightmare?

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM LETHARGY?

Lethargy is a third-person game where the player controls a character named Diana. She wakes up in a completely unknown place, a sci-fi-like room, but she doesn't find it strange, as she believes what's happening is just a dream.

However, the events that occur during her journey make her question whether it's really a dream or pure reality.

Initially, she is completely unarmed, but as she progresses through the challenges and levels of the game, she acquires a powerful multi-shot weapon capable of firing infinite projectiles, albeit with low damage, lasers, grenades, sticky grenades, and flamethrowers!

A SCI-FI AND MYSTERIOUS LOCATION.

As the story progresses, the setting only changes in size and shape, but remains the same, as if Diana's mind is changing, not her surroundings.

Rooms, corridors, or gigantic spaces may appear, but they always maintain the same appearance.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

As soon as she wakes up, Diana meets a little drone named RAV. He'll guide her to the exit. He'll give her tips on how to get through each level and help her destroy some enemies if she's incapacitated. But be careful! RAV is powerful, but limited! So try to recover quickly before RAV's power runs out.

SINISTER ENEMIES?

Beware of the enemies that will challenge our heroine Diana! Dolls with powerful kicks can cause a lot of trouble, as well as monsters and other types of diabolical enemies.

ARMED YOURSELF

You'll have to overcome some challenges without weapons, simply by running away and using strategies to defeat the enemies. Use lights and available items scattered throughout the environment to defeat them.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent violence or bloody violence, General adult content.
The character uses a weapon with piercing ammunition, which can cause enemies, which may be demonic entities or ferocious beasts, to bleed, be blown up, or beheaded.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 3GB, AMD RX 470 4GB, Intel UHD graphics 630

short_description: Lethargy: Wake up or sleep forever! With the RAV drone, explore, run, escape, or destroy terrifying enemies. In this third-person shooter! Is it a nightmare or reality? Discover the truth before the line between sleep and wakefulness blurs.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Italian, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, German, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
